sourceReview.reason: Off-topic watchlist discovery: the underlying 2026-11-18 Anthropic IPO and concurrent private placement are conventional equity issuance, not a documented tokenized-stock launch or RWA issuance. Full Reuters and CoinDesk coverage discusses IPO pricing and proceeds but establishes no tokenized Anthropic shares. Headline's generic tokenized-stocks reference is not a separate verifiable RWA event; reject rather than manufacture a tokenization angle.
